title: Hexed Raises Questions About Disney's Original Animation Strategy
excerpt:
Early reviews of Disney's new original feature are mixed.
Box-office projections remain estimates rather than actual results.
body_md:
Disney has enjoyed billion-dollar successes with animated sequels, but original properties remain important to its long-term creative strategy. Hexed is Walt Disney Animation's first non-sequel since 2023's Wish, which received a 48 percent critics' score and grossed $254 million worldwide.

Early reactions are mixed. Some reviewers admire the visuals more than the narrative, while others appreciate its emphasis on young girls and empowerment. It is too early to establish a final critical consensus or audience response.

Hailee Steinfeld voices Billie, a teenager discovering magical abilities. Rashida Jones plays her protective mother and Jodie Foster voices the antagonist. Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller co-wrote the film.

The report cites a projection of roughly $40 million behind the new Hunger Games film. This is a forecast, not a confirmed gross. The writer's concern is whether Disney can establish another successful original property; audiences will ultimately determine the outcome.
